claims.statement: For arbitrary signs sigma_k and ranks r_k>=2 on fresh disjoint point-defect blocks, U(P)<=8I(P)/3 implies U(F_d)<=8I(F_d)/3 at every finite depth.
claims.scope: Uniform in dimension, depth, rank, rarity and sign sequence; fair outer selectors.

claims.statement: Every finite adaptive/pruned physical restriction tree with one common disjoint terminal core has retained U-loss at most 8I(F_d)/3.
First-revelation ownership across changing or overlapping coherent cores remains unproved.
